purpose: Add a causally available Lean author usage control to the already frozen whole-source utility-gate comparisons, without another deletion or video inference run.
usage: At each source's subsequent read, use the author's raw attention-usage vector captured before its pruning decision. Convert the full 4096 values to average tie-aware percentile ranks within that source, then average ranks over that source's actual 1024 retained keys. High score means high prior usage. Only measurements whose read precedes the fixed target and whose retained token IDs are exactly verified are allowed. This score is query-specific prior attention, not true utility.
selection: For each fixed read remove the one complete source with lowest mean historical usage rank, matching the gate and other source-selection methods at 1024 deleted keys. Stable ties select lower group index. Compare to pre-existing label-free LOSO trained gate, uniform contrast, RGB, shuffled and age controls. Also report the mean of five source deletions and the mean of five independently fixed mixed-source random deletions; the latter is a descriptive distributed-across-sources expectation, not a learned policy or propagated system. All use the same raw read, eligible key universe and deletion count.
verification_and_limits: Scores must be generated without reading target labels or deletion outcomes; freeze and repeat them before joining independently audited mask outcomes. Hash-check usage/source captures, LOSO predictions and both fixed replay verifications. Source-pruning usage must match frozen prior-read attention and exact retained positions. These reads and outcomes were inspected previously; group effects are small and dependent, patient independence unverified, and one eligible empty read cannot assess reliability. No target-read attention as a pre-read baseline, no redetection, threshold, GT-derived inference signal, or propagation claim.
